findings.title: Transfer debits without a transaction
findings.explanation: The $transaction wrapper was removed; a failed credit leaves the debit applied.
findings.evidence: await db.account.update({ where: { id: from.id }, data: { credits: from.credits - amount } });
findings.trigger: The credit update fails (constraint, timeout) after the debit
findings.violatedInvariant: A transfer applies both writes or neither

Transfer debits without a transaction.decisiveCode:
await db.account.update({ where: { id: from.id }, data: { credits: from.credits - amount } });
await db.account.update({ where: { id: to.id }, data: { credits: to.credits + amount } });
Transfer debits without a transaction.reachableTrigger: The credit update throws after the debit

guardsOnPath.whyNotPreventing: Validates input only; it cannot undo a debit when the later credit fails.
